At a Massachusetts community pharmacy, the pharmacist is on duty and available. Each proposed assignment below is evaluated with the employee’s current state license and certification. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

A.original_choice_text: A trained cashier selects an unfilled prescription stock bottle and counts tablets before ringing up the sale.
A.finding_ko: 틀리다. cashier는 filled/verified/bagged 처방 판매·상담 제안 전달 경로이며 미조제 stock bottle 선택·정제 계수는 아니다. 교육만으로 면허 없는 처방약 handling 권한을 얻지 않는다.
A.effective_date_or_version: Adopted2020-12-18; latest listed revision2026-09-03; separate effective date not displayed

B.original_choice_text: A pharmacist performs final patient-specific prescription verification after an intern prepares the medication.
B.finding_ko: 맞다. intern이 준비해도 최종 처방 검증은 pharmacist가 수행한다. 정책은 intern의 pharmacist와 같은 업무 범위에서 final prescription verification을 명시적으로 제외한다.
B.effective_date_or_version: Adopted2020-12-18; latest listed revision2026-09-03; separate effective date not displayed

C.original_choice_text: A supervised nationally certified technician counsels a patient about a newly prescribed inhaler.
C.finding_ko: 틀리다. 새 inhaler의 임상 상담은 pharmacist/intern 업무이다. national certification과 supervision은 technician의 상담 금지를 해제하지 않는다.
C.effective_date_or_version: Official PDF footer2024-12-06; original effective dates of each cited clause not established

D.original_choice_text: A licensed technician without national certification accepts a new verbal prescription for gabapentin with pharmacist approval.
D.finding_ko: 틀리다. 새 verbal ScheduleIII–VI 처방 수령은 licensed nationally certified technician의 추가 업무이다. 미인증 technician에게 pharmacist가 승인했다는 사실만으로 범위가 확장되지 않는다. gabapentin의 PMP 보고 여부와 새 전화처방 수령 tier는 별도이다.
D.effective_date_or_version: Adopted2020-12-18; latest listed revision2026-09-03; separate effective date not displayed

The manager is reviewing staffing assignments under Massachusetts Policy 2026-02. The stated support personnel are actively assisting prescription preparation unless the option specifies another role. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

A.original_choice_text: One pharmacist supervises three support staff who are all ordinary technicians.
A.finding_ko: 틀리다. ordinary technician 3명만으로 1:3은 충족하지 않는다. 3명 중 licensed intern 또는 licensed certified technician이 적어도 1명이어야 한다.
A.effective_date_or_version: Adopted2026-09-03, supersedes2024-03; separate effective date not displayed

B.original_choice_text: A domestic pharmacy student receives a Massachusetts intern license before beginning a hospital internship.
B.finding_ko: 맞다. 국내·외국 학교 학생 모두 hospital을 포함한 모든 setting에서 internship 시작 전에 Massachusetts intern license를 확인해야 한다. student ID만의 대체 경로가 아니다.
B.effective_date_or_version: Adopted2026-09-03, supersedes2024-03; separate effective date not displayed

C.original_choice_text: A pharmacist preceptor directly supervises four interns who also fill prescriptions throughout the clinic.
C.finding_ko: 틀리다. 4 intern 허용은 filling/환자안전 위험 업무 없는 비약국 상황 또는 exclusively immunization clinic 등의 명시 조건이다. clinic에서 일반 prescription filling을 병행하면 exclusive-clinic 예외를 충족하지 않는다.
C.effective_date_or_version: Adopted2026-09-03, supersedes2024-03; separate effective date not displayed

D.original_choice_text: An employee scheduled for computer training is excluded while also interrupting modules to fill waiting prescriptions.
D.finding_ko: 틀리다. computer-training 제외는 정해진 시간에 오직 모듈만 수행하고 professional pharmacist support를 하지 않는 조건이다. waiting prescription filling을 병행하면 제외되지 않는다.
D.effective_date_or_version: Adopted2026-09-03, supersedes2024-03; separate effective date not displayed

records.original_stem:
The manager is reviewing staffing assignments under Massachusetts Policy 2026-02. The stated support personnel are actively assisting prescription preparation unless the option specifies another role. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

A.original_choice_text: One pharmacist supervises four support staff consisting of one certified technician and three ordinary technicians.
A.finding_ko: 틀리다. 4명은 CPhT+intern 각1, CPhT2 또는 intern2 중 하나가 필요하다. CPhT1+ordinary3에는 요구된 2명 자격 조합이 없다.
A.effective_date_or_version: Adopted2026-09-03, supersedes2024-03; separate effective date not displayed

B.original_choice_text: A trainer and trainee are designated on the posted schedule before the training day, with written procedures in place.
B.finding_ko: 맞다. written P&P, 특정 날짜·시간, training 당일 전 trainer/trainee schedule 지정이 필요하다. 제시된 행위는 그 사전 절차를 충족하며 명찰·직접감독 등 다른 전제도 별도로 충족해야 한다.
B.effective_date_or_version: Adopted2026-09-03, supersedes2024-03; separate effective date not displayed

C.original_choice_text: A dedicated trainer is excluded while independently filling prescriptions between trainee demonstrations.
C.finding_ko: 틀리다. dedicated trainer라도 독립 filling을 하면 trainer–trainee 관계 밖 professional support이므로 ratio에 포함해야 한다. 시범 사이 filling도 제외 조건을 충족하지 못한다.
C.effective_date_or_version: Adopted2026-09-03, supersedes2024-03; separate effective date not displayed

D.original_choice_text: A pharmacy not providing vaccination services uses the special six-support-staff ratio based only on having three certified technicians.
D.finding_ko: 틀리다. special1:6은 vaccination services 제공 pharmacy에 대한 경로이다. 제공하지 않는 약국이 CPhT3명만을 이유로 일반 filling ratio를 늘릴 수 없다.

A HIPAA-covered Massachusetts pharmacy receives requests involving identifiable patient information. No emergency disclosure exception or special judicial order applies unless stated. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

A.original_choice_text: A billing employee opens a neighbor’s prescription profile to satisfy personal curiosity, using a valid work login.
A.finding_ko: 틀리다. valid work login은 curiosity access의 허가가 아니다. workforce의 업무·역할별 필요 PHI 접근을 식별·제한해야 하며 이웃의 profile을 호기심으로 열람하는 것은 payment 업무가 아니다. 치료 공개에 적용되는 minimum-necessary 예외와 혼동하지 않는다.
A.effective_date_or_version: eCFR government current consolidation Displaying title 45, up to date as of 10/30/2026.; individual amendment effective dates not separately verified

B.original_choice_text: A pharmacy treats the Security Rule as its only obligation and leaves printed patient records publicly exposed.
B.finding_ko: 틀리다. printed PHI도 Privacy Rule의 적절한 safeguards 대상이다. Security Rule만을 의무라고 취급하여 paper records를 공개 노출하는 것은 허용되지 않는다. ePHI만의 기술통제와 PHI privacy 범위를 구분한다.
B.effective_date_or_version: eCFR government current consolidation Displaying title 45, up to date as of 10/30/2026.; individual amendment effective dates not separately verified

C.original_choice_text: A pharmacy silently takes repeated 30-day extensions because its records are stored offsite.
C.finding_ko: 틀리다. 최대30일 연장은 한 번뿐이며 최초30일 안에 사유와 완료예정일을 서면 통지해야 한다. offsite보관은 silent repeated extensions를 허용하지 않는다.

D.original_choice_text: A pharmacy acts on a patient access request within 30 calendar days unless a compliant extension is used.
D.finding_ko: 맞다. access request는 수령 후 늦어도30일 내 조치하고, 불가피한 경우 최초기간 내 서면 사유·예정일과 단1회의 최대30일 연장을 적용한다. 더 빠른 처리가 가능해도30일을 꼭 기다리라는 뜻은 아니다.

Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

A.original_choice_text: A pharmacist marks the patient as having no known allergies without inquiry because the imported allergy field is empty.
A.finding_ko: 틀리다. empty imported allergy field는 confirmed no known allergies가 아니다. reasonable effort로 known drug allergies/reactions 정보를 수집·기록하고 DUR에 반영해야 한다.

B.effective_date_or_version: Official PDF footer2024-12-06; original effective dates of each cited clause not established

C.original_choice_text: A pharmacist treats a successful barcode match as completing the legal-purpose and prescriber-authority assessment.
C.finding_ko: 틀리다. barcode matching은 제품 정확성 점검이며 prescription의 legitimate medical purpose·authenticity·valid relationship·prescriber authority의 별도 professional judgment를 대체하지 않는다.
C.effective_date_or_version: Official PDF footer2024-12-06; original effective dates of each cited clause not established

D.finding_ko: 맞다. auto-refill enrollment 전에 patient/agent consent를 obtain AND record해야 한다. 선택지는 obtain을 제시하며 기록과 중단방법 등 나머지 조건은 stem의 other prerequisites 전제에 포함된다.
D.effective_date_or_version: Official PDF footer2024-12-06; original effective dates of each cited clause not established
